_how: Worked by hand from pearl_street_peak.yaml before the first run, using Pearl Street's M1 rules (clearing: merit order by floor then arrival, uniform price = floor of the last accepted offer; settlement: credit = price x delivered kW x 3 h / 1000, shortfall charge = price cap x (awarded - delivered) kW x 3 h / 1000). Physics: an asset follows its award up to its attested power. After the first run, two non-numeric fields were corrected: Town's standing check is named privacy and reports not_tested (it had been written as privacy_clean: passed), and verdict was added. No numeric value changed. The honest_providers_unharmed stage was added later, with the fault-injection variants, to make harm to honest providers explicit; in this fault-free run it passes.
